_comment: DRAFT — machine-translated into Modern Standard Arabic (العربية) from en.json, NOT yet reviewed by a native speaker. Do not ship to users until a native speaker has proofread it, with particular attention to money (wallet, withdrawal, transfer, floorPrice), legal (deleteAccount, legal, register) and safety (shield, shieldActivateSheet, shieldBeneficiaries) sections. Arabic is right-to-left: the app must enable RTL layout when this language is active (see the rtl flag in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES in i18n/index.js). Arabic uses six plural forms (zero, one, two, few, many, other), so plural keys carry all six suffixes. Arrow glyphs are flipped (← for forward) to suit RTL. Adding a new language: copy this file's key structure exactly, translate every value, then add an entry to SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES in i18n/index.js.
